name: nli-deberta-large
description: DeBERTa-v3-large zero-shot entailment model (435M). Each answer becomes a hypothesis judged against the input. Zero-shot, no fine-tuning by this project.

calibration.note: Fitted with training/calibrate.py on held-back rows of data/calib.jsonl (public gold-labelled tasks): choice and yes/no minimise negative log-likelihood, score minimises the error of the expected level.

summary: The smallest and fastest: under 1 GB and about 0.08 s, strong on simple questions.
use_when: Clear-cut classification: intents, topics, spam, sentiment (94% on the easy tier).
Laptops without much memory, or the first run on a new machine (a 0.9 GB download).
Bulk jobs over many short items.
avoid_when: Policy and rule application, or anything that needs several steps of reasoning.
Long documents: it reads only about 512 tokens, keeping the start and the end.
